topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The rain’s been coming down all night, painting the streets in that familiar slick of inevitable decay. I couldn’t sleep, so I grabbed a Scotch, the good stuff, and let the thoughts swirl like the whiskey in my glass. Then, the call. A new place, they said. A clean slate, until they stumbled on a door behind the wall. Hidden. Bolstered shut, like they were trying to keep the past in—or something else out. They couldn’t get it open, but the door’s got secrets, and it’s whispering through the cracks. I’ll take the case. Something’s always hiding, after all. Might as well find out what this one’s got stashed away.
